app.name: JobRadar
app.tagline: Job postings scored against your profile

errors.network_error: The API is unreachable. Is it running?
errors.contract: The API answered with an unexpected format.
errors.ai_budget_exceeded: The daily AI budget is used up. Try again tomorrow or raise AI_DAILY_BUDGET_USD.
errors.ai_not_configured: No AI provider is configured on the API.
errors.ai_refused: The AI refused to score this posting.
errors.ai_provider_error: The AI provider failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.cv_not_pdf: That file is not a PDF.
errors.cv_too_long: The CV has too many pages (15 at most).
errors.cv_no_text: The PDF has no readable text. Scanned CVs are not supported; export a text PDF instead.
errors.cv_too_large: The file is too large (5 MB at most).
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.email_taken: There is already an account with that email.
errors.weak_password: That password is not acceptable. Use at least 10 characters and not your email.
errors.signup_disabled: Registration is closed on this server.
errors.bad_origin: This request came from an address the server does not trust.
errors.too_many_tokens: You already have 10 active tokens. Revoke one first.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Please log in again.

add.title: Add a posting
add.intro: Paste the posting text. Everything else is optional: missing title and company are guessed.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: Postings are scored against this profile.
profile.empty: No profile yet. Fill it in and save to start scoring.
profile.stackHint: Type a technology and press Enter
profile.locationsHint: ISO country code (BO), latam or worldwide; press Enter
profile.english: Highest English level required that you accept
profile.invalidLocation: Use a country code like BO, or latam / worldwide.

cv.title: Import from your CV
cv.intro: Upload your CV as a PDF and the profile below is filled in for you. Nothing is saved until you review it and press Save.
cv.privacy: The text of your CV is sent to the AI provider configured for this app to extract your data. Name, email and phone are never requested or stored.
cv.wait: Reading your CV, this can take a few seconds.
cv.banner: Draft from your CV. Review every section and press Save to keep it.

warnings.no_stack: No technologies were found: add your stack.
warnings.location_missing: No country was found: add where you can work from.
warnings.seniority_estimated: Seniority was estimated from your years of experience.
warnings.seniority_missing: Your years of experience could not be worked out: choose your seniority.
warnings.english_level_missing: No English level was found: B1 was assumed, set the right one.
warnings.text_truncated: The CV was very long: only the first part was read.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.hint: Type a certification and press Enter

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Enter your email and password.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Your postings, profile and AI budget are private to your account.
register.tooShort: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens let n8n and scripts act on your account without your password. Each token shows its secret only once.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.secretWarning: Copy it now: it is shown only this once and cannot be recovered. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.
tokens.useIt: For n8n, put it in your .env as
